bagPolicy.summary: Bags larger than 14" x 12" x 6" (35.56 cm x 30.48 cm x 15.24 cm) are not allowed. Only personal handbags and bags with baby items are permitted.
allowed: Personal handbags up to 14" x 12" x 6"
prohibited: Glass, hard plastic or metal containers
bagPolicy.note: All bags are inspected, and a metal detector may be used at some events. Guests who refuse inspection are denied entry without refund. Wrapped gifts must be opened for inspection. The promoter can prohibit additional items.

parking.note: Parking is accessible via Soumande St. and Avenue du Colisée. Customers have free access to the P2B parking lot via Soumande St., except on event days when parking fees apply.

rideshare.note: For taxi pickup, use the stand east of the arena in front of the Colisée, in parking lot P4.

concessions.note: The Videotron Centre offers a variety of high-quality food concessions with menus to suit all tastes and budgets, including gourmet options in premium areas. Club Bud lounge bar provides a wide selection of Labatt beers in a festive atmosphere.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: To buy reduced-mobility and companion seats on ticketmaster.ca, turn on Filters and click Accessibility. Guests with reduced mobility and their companions can enter through door 9, near the P1 lot for disabled badge holders, and elevators are throughout the arena. Free wheelchairs are available at the information desk while supplies last, with valid ID such as a driver's license as a deposit.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is prohibited without prior approval and a stamp. Arrange permission before leaving.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Tickets are mobile and managed in the Ticketmaster app. Screenshots, photos, and print-outs of mobile tickets are not accepted. If you don't have a credit card, you can buy tickets in person at the Videotron Centre box office with a debit card.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The main entrance is on Soumande St., and the secondary entrance is at Avenue du Colisée and Hamel Blvd. Guests with reduced mobility and their companions can use door 9, near the P1 lot for disabled badge holders. Update the Ticketmaster app before you go and show your tickets from the app or your digital wallet at the entrance.
